claims.citation: New York Herald, 4 July 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pennsylvania (Br), Lewis, Liverpool June 13,
via Queenstown 16th, with mdse and 381[?] passengers, to the
National Steam Navigation Co. June 18, lat 51 16, lon 16 16,
spoke steamship City of Cork; 19th, lat 51 02, lon 19 18, steam-
ship City of London; 20th, lat 50 13, lon 26 48, steamship
Persia; 23d, lat 43 12, lon 37 11, steamship Denmark—all
hence for Liverpool; 29th, lat 42[?] 32, lon 57 25, ship Mary Lyon
(Br), bound W.
